opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to achieve their full potential, covering consumables, equipment, and related costs.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research.
opportunities.summary: Supports members developing new educational resources or conducting publishable educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports members conducting pilot studies, developing new techniques, or finalising projects, and activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles within physiological sciences.
